name: small-web
description: The Small Web - The sites and the browser you read them in

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
